maya: Quick note 7 I'm opening a small clean-up PR for the "welcome-runner" quickstart. Goals: one-command local start, unify env var to WELCOME_TOKEN, repair the SDK v9 link, and add a tiny /health smoke test. I'll add files under examples/welcome-runner.

trent: Nice. Single-command UX = `cp .env.sample .env && npm ci && npm run start`? Keep Docker but make npm path easiest.

maya: Yep. README will show that and include a start script that loads .env if present. .env.sample snippet:```bash
WELCOME_TOKEN=your_token_here
WELCOME_REGION=us-west1
```

nora: Can we include a migration note for LEGACY_SECRET -> WELCOME_TOKEN? People still hit the old secret name.

maya: Will do: short line in auth section saying set WELCOME_TOKEN to your legacy secret value in CI or rename secret.

trent: Also replace the old SDK link with https://sdk.redwood.ai/v9/quickstart and add docs linkcheck in CI.

ci-bot: queued: docs/linkcheck on draft PR.

maya: Draft PR #5310 created. Checklist: add examples/welcome-runner, .env.sample + start script, update README quick run, replace SDK link to v9, add migration note, add docs CI linkcheck, add examples/test/smoke.test.js asserting /health returns 200.

trent: I'll take CI/linkcheck updates. Nora will proof copy/screens. I'll run a repo grep for LEGACY_SECRET and list results in PR comments.

nora: Small accessibility nit: update screenshot alt text to "Welcome Runner sample app".

ci-bot: linkcheck: external links OK. examples smoke: failing (pre-fix).

maya: Pushed fix to start.js to expose /health. Re-run CI.

ci-bot: examples smoke: passing. linkcheck: OK.

trent: LGTM from ops side. Merge once docs review approves.

nora: Approved and left tiny copy punctuation tweak.

maya: Merged PR #5310. Will announce in #announcements after site rebuild. Thanks all!
